question: Should workflow completion automation use the existing typed plugin `session_end` hook, or should OpenClaw add a new internal `session:end` hook event for operator-installed `HOOK.md` scripts?
rationale: Current main has a real plugin lifecycle hook but not the requested internal hook, and repository vision prefers plugin/API extension surfaces unless a core internal-hook gap remains.

options.title: Bless plugin session_end
options.body: Document `session_end` as the supported completion signal for workflow integrations and close or narrow this internal-hook request if that covers the use case.

options.title: Add internal session:end
options.body: Define a typed internal event and wire it through reset, shutdown, cron/agent, and subagent completion paths if maintainers want `HOOK.md` scripts to own this automation contract.

options.title: Defer to linked PR review
options.body: Keep this issue open until the partial reset-hook pull request and related session-memory reports are resolved, then reassess the remaining hook boundary.

recommendation.title: Bless plugin session_end
recommendation.body: Document `session_end` as the supported completion signal for workflow integrations and close or narrow this internal-hook request if that covers the use case.
